reviews.t: Really red for the light brown.
reviews.x: I was really excited to try this brow pen. I ordered it in light brown. Sadly, it’s super red based! I’m fair and have naturally blonde hair and very cool skin tones. As you can see in my photo, it is a terrible color me. If you have warm hair or auburn hair, you may like the product. If you are blonde, fair and don’t like warm tones, i would not buy this!  UPDATE: after my review, they gave me a full refund and a nice note. Good customer service!

I was not happy with the color at all. I have blonde hair and thought the light brown would be perfect however it has a very red tone to it so it looks like a light orange when you put it on.  The company reached out to me to be sure I was happy, I let them know I was not and now they are sending me the chestnut at no charge!  I do like how this product goes on and I will say that I think the reason people are talking about it drying up is because it does not go on well over the top of foundatio

I am very fair skinned but have medium brown hair.  Prefer eyebrows to be a bit darker but not too dark.  Thought I'd try the Chestnut.  It looks very orange to me.  Will return and try a darker color maybe.  Still debating.  I love the idea of how this works.
I love the applicator and the longevity of the liquid, but the color for light brown is not light brown. It is a brick color. It might work for redheads.

Wow! This eyebrow pen is terrific and the customer service is fantastic!  I was reluctant to write a review at first. My daughter always tells me to go darker with my eyebrows. I tend to prefer lighter, so when I ordered I chose Light Brown.  I was excited when my order arrived. I loved the look. The color glided on smooth and even. The comb really made shaping easy.  However, the color is too light. I would call it more of a blonde.  The seller emailed me to ask me to write a review. Instead of
I purchased this in light brown and it's a little too red for me, the actual pen works great. Seller got in touch with me immediately and is sending me a different color.

reviews.t: Hoping for higher quality but Great Customer Service
reviews.x: Hard to see individual lines. The light brown color is more golden brown than I expected. Great customer service, they reached out to me directly & offered a refund.
The product is great.  Takes some practice. So don't get discouraged, keep working at it.  And customer service is awesome
Light brown apparently means bright orange. Does not make nice fine lines.
Cap was full of leaked “ink” when I opened it. Faulty. Requesting refund.

Okay first of all I want to comment on the epic customer service I received from this company. The first brow pen was way wrong color wise and without hesitation they let me keep it and sent me a new one in the correct color. They stayed in contact until they knew I was satisfied, as far as customer service goes, it's doesn't get better.  Now the brow pen. I love it! The formula is pigmented and super easygoing to use. It can look very natural or glam depending how hard you push it. The best par

I love the pen, not a fan of the color...It's the same color I'd buy in any brand but it's a weird  shade of brown with kind of a reddish look to it. Also the pen should be stored upright, which is inconvenient if you use a make up bag. Not for me. After my review, the seller did contact me to asked if i'd like a refund, I appreciate the customer service. I actually am keeping it to see if someone in my group can use it. It goes on well and stays on, just like I said, not for me.

reviews.t: Easy to use but does not last
reviews.x: I like how the application head is structured because it makes the pencil easy to use. Unfortunately, mine ran out of pencil after a single use. For that reason, this has been the most expensive brow pencil I have ever purchased. I am very disappointed with my purchase.  UPDATE: While I still don't believe this to be a good product, I change my original rating to express my appreciation for the kind and courteous customer service I've received.

I purchased the light red brown/strawberry blond and it was an exact match. Honestly, I think I could even go darker. At any rate, it goes on easily and lasts until you take it off. Easy to get that nice clean outline and fill in for the perfect look. I really love the applicator. I used two Benefit products to achieve the same thing as this one product....and it is a LOT cheaper. Will certainly buy again!

I read all the reviews before ordering this product and still managed to  purchase the wrong color.  The product itself works very well, but the colors represented are wrong.  I ordered the brown and received a very light reddish blonde color and it is no where close to the color depicted on Amazon.  I gave three stars because I think it is a good product for the price if it  arrived in the right color.

I really try to leave only positive reviews, but this particular time, I just can't.  I purchased the Eyebrow tattoo pen because I'd seen it on social media (so its claims HAD to be true *wink wink*). This pen is simply an unremarkable marker. Won't be a regular purchase for me.

I like the ease of the product and the application of it. The color is a bit reddish once on but I think the brown color may be too dark for a natural look on me. A taupe color would work better for my skin tone and blond hair coloring.  Nice product.

Seems to work as expected, but was disappointing to receive it boxed in packaging that read, "GIVEAWAY." Leads me to believe these items may be leftover products from a giveaway promotion and therefore not as fresh as I might otherwise receive.

I’m used to using a pencil so unfortunately this product did not work for me but my daughter tried it and now she uses it everyday and loves it! She’s really good at doing her eyebrows and it looks amazing on her!

reviews.t: Worked Well - Not The Right Color
reviews.x: Overall, this  product is really great however what didn’t work for me was the color.  I ordered the brown and it had too much red in it for me.  That’s the only reason I gave it a 3 star overall  rating.
I love the fork like applicator because when applied you have hair strokes on your brow.  It looks natural compared to being applied with a solid pencil.  The blonde is the right one for me.

reviews.t: Definitely not the color for blonde!
reviews.x: This product goes on and stays on as advertised but the color is all off. This comes off bright red/orange and is definitely not something I can get away with wearing. Very disappointed.
Color was not appropriate for me. Much to dark and too red. I was offered some type compensation but no big deal. Too much trouble to follow up. Lesson learned. I do not blame seller.
The customer service is amazing!  I ordered the wrong color and they fixed it so easily!  The new color they’re sending is going to match perfectly!  Awesome brows are in my future!!
Great eyebrow pencil for sparse eyebrows or for eyebrows that need just a little filling in. Amazing customer service!!! If you have any questions, they are quick to respond.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the light brown shade has a strong red or orange tone that doesn't match expectations.
Reviewers frequently praise the excellent customer service, with the seller reaching out and sending replacement colors or refunds.
The pen's applicator and ease of use are commonly liked.
Some reviewers report the product runs out quickly or leaks.
A few reviewers note the product takes practice and doesn't make fine lines easily.
